system.description: While you have 3 or more Nature Energy, your arm enlarges and your bones shift to create a massive mace like appendage. For the duration, your Unarmed damage die becomes a d10, deals piercing damage, and each successful unarmed attack, forces the target to make a Strength saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC, gaining the Bruised condition until the end of your next turn.
